title: The Stolen Cloud Raft
story: Vaporix the Drift Thief has hooked a cloud raft full of lantern-makers and is towing it away over the valley at a steady 5 leagues per hour. Mr 6 leaps aboard a wind-skiff that races at 12 leagues per hour, but the thief already has a 3.5-league head start. The lantern-makers wave; Mr 6 waves back and does the arithmetic before touching the tiller.
question: If Mr 6 flies at 12 leagues per hour and Vaporix drifts at 5 leagues per hour with a 3.5-league head start, how many minutes until Mr 6 catches the cloud raft?
solution: Mr 6 gains on the raft at 12 - 5 = 7 leagues per hour.
praise: Using a gap-divided-by-speed plan was the right move — the missing piece was gaining only on the DIFFERENCE of the two speeds (and turning hours into minutes).
hint: Mr 6 isn't closing the gap at 12 leagues per hour, because the raft keeps moving too. How much faster is he than the raft?
victory: Half an hour later Mr 6 slid alongside and unhooked the tow line with a polite tap. Vaporix sped off at 5 leagues per hour, which, as everyone now knew, was simply not fast enough.
imagePrompt: A caped numeral-six knight steering a small wind-skiff through bright sunset clouds, closing on a misty thief-wraith towing a raft of frightened lantern-makers high above a patchwork valley.
